# Create an environment correlation matrix plot

Create an environment correlation matrix plot

## Usage

``` r
plot_env_correlation(df, gen_col, env_col, trait, method = "pearson")
```

## Arguments

- df:

  Data frame

- gen_col:

  Genotype column

- env_col:

  Environment column

- trait:

  Trait column

- method:

  Correlation method: "pearson", "spearman", or "kendall"

## Value

plotly object

## Examples

``` r
trial <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "example_phenotypic.csv", package = "MERIDIAN"))
plot_env_correlation(trial, "Genotype", "Environment", "GrainYield")
```
